fields.name: Utah Workforce Services · Salt Lake Metro Job Help
fields.description: Free help with resumes, applications and finding work. Training assistance has separate eligibility rules.
fields.address: 720 South 200 East, Salt Lake City, UT

informationSections.programsAndServices: Help with job searches, resumes, applications and interviews. Ask about training assistance if you need new skills.
informationSections.eligibilityRequirements: Training funding requires an eligibility review; being eligible for job-search help does not guarantee funding.
informationSections.howToBestConnect: Visit the Salt Lake Metro Employment Center or use the DWS website. Call the DWS service number to confirm office hours before traveling.
informationSections.access: Salt Lake City. You can apply for career and education services in person; online applications require a UtahID account.
informationSections.importantInformationToKnow: For career and education assistance, a counselor contacts you to arrange an appointment and explains required documents. Submit required information within 45 days.
